objectives: 本課程講授現代分子醫學知識, 著重基礎知識與臨床醫學應用原理, 增強學生對醫學相關領域的了解。
content:
1. Molecular genetics-I
2. Molecular genetics-II
3. Molecular technology-I
4. Molecular technology-II
5. Eukaryotic transcription
6. Transcription regulation-I
7. Transcrition regulation-II
8. Translation
9. Midterm exam
10. DNA damage and repair-I
11. DNA damage and repair-II
12. Molecular cancer biology-I
13. Molecular cancer biology-II
14. Basic immunology-I
15. Basic immunology-II
16. Final exam
books: Lewin‘s GENES XII (Jocelyn E. Krebs, Elliott S. Goldstein, Stephen T. Kilpatrick)
grading_policy: 期中考: 40％ 期末考: 40％ 出席率: 20％
